goals: Enable admins to create new blog posts (as Gists) from within the application.
Restrict admin access to authenticated users (via GitHub/Gist).
Ensure newly created Gists appear on the main page after saving.

userStories.title: Admin access with Gist authentication
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to access an administration page that requires Gist authentication so that only authorised users can manage content.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Unauthenticated users visiting `/admin` (or equivalent) are redirected to GitHub OAuth/Gist login.
After successful authentication, the admin reaches an admin dashboard.
Unauthenticated requests to admin routes return 401 or redirect to login.

userStories.title: Create posts with Markdown editor
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to create new Gists through the admin page using a Markdown editor so that I can author posts without leaving the application.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Admin can open a "New post" form with a Markdown editor (title + body).
Editor supports Markdown syntax (headings, lists, links, code blocks).
Form validates required fields (title, body) before allowing save.

userStories.title: Save Gist and view created posts
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to save the post to Gist and see my created posts so that I can confirm the content is stored and visible.

acceptanceCriteria.text: "Save" button creates a new Gist via the GitHub API using the authenticated user's token.
After save, the admin sees success feedback and the new post in a list of their posts.
The newly created Gist is visible on the main page (post list) after save.
Save failure (network, API error) shows a clear error message.

functionalRequirements.description: Admin routes (`/admin`, `/admin/*`) are protected; unauthenticated users cannot access them.
Authentication uses GitHub OAuth (or equivalent) scoped for Gist read/write.
Admin dashboard displays a "New post" action and a list of posts created by the authenticated user.
Markdown editor allows editing title and body; body supports standard Markdown.
Gist creation uses the GitHub API with the authenticated user's token; new Gists are associated with the user's account.
The main page shows all Gists (no filtering); newly created Gists by the admin appear automatically in the list.
